backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a personalized user dashboard with role-based access control, storing per-principal visit counts, last login times, and preferences, with public query/update methods gated by user/admin roles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features (personalized dashboard UI and React Query hooks) to their source files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, covering styles, components, hooks, config, and content files for the Terra Vedant Tech application.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Comprehensive production deployment guide for deploying to Internet Computer mainnet, covering prerequisites, automated and manual deployment steps, retry procedures, verification, and troubleshooting.
frontend/index.css: Root CSS file defining Tailwind base/components/utilities and OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including sidebar, chart, and semantic UI tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with full SEO metadata (Open Graph, Twitter Card, JSON-LD Organization schema), LCP hero image preload, and the React app root div for Terra Vedant Tech.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt allowing all crawlers and pointing to the sitemap URL at terravedanttech.com.
frontend/scripts/deploy-ic.ts: Automated IC mainnet deployment script that sequentially runs preflight checks, builds the frontend, and deploys via dfx, exiting on any step failure.
frontend/scripts/preflight-production.ts: Pre-deployment preflight script that runs TypeScript compilation and static asset verification checks, exiting with a non-zero code if either check fails.
frontend/scripts/verify-assets.ts: Preflight script that checks all required static assets (logo, generated images, hero background) exist in the public/assets directory before a production build, exiting with an error if any are missing.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component that composes the full page layout by rendering the header, hero, dashboard, about, services, contact sections, and footer inside a production error boundary.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Controlled React form component with client-side validation for name, email, and message fields, simulating async submission and displaying success or error alerts.
frontend/src/components/ProductionErrorB: React class-based error boundary that catches uncaught runtime errors and renders a fallback UI with a reload button instead of crashing the entire app.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section that displays a title, descriptive paragraph from marketing copy, and three value cards (Sustainability, Innovation, Partnership) with icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact section that renders contact information (email, address, phone) alongside the ContactForm component in a two-column layout.
frontend/src/components/sections/Dashboa: Renders a personalized dashboard section for authenticated users, displaying visit count, user preferences (display name, preferred contact topic), and allowing users to update those preferences via form inputs backed by React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Renders the full-screen hero section with a background image, headline, and CTA buttons; shows a personalized welcome message for authenticated users and the default marketing copy for guests.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Renders a grid of service cards (smart irrigation, analytics, IoT, drones, software, consulting) using content from marketingCopy and mapped Lucide icons.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Site footer component displaying the brand name, tagline, quick-navigation links, and conditionally rendered social media icons (LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook) based on URL validity.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Fixed site header with scroll-aware background, desktop and mobile navigation, and Internet Identity login/logout buttons that reflect authentication state.
frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts: Exports a centralized BRAND_ASSETS constant containing paths to logo variants (large, standard, header) and the hero background image.
frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts: Exports static marketing copy objects for the hero, about, services, and contact sections of the site.
frontend/src/content/socialLinks.ts: Exports constants for the company's LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook URLs used across the site.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook that manage ICP Internet Identity authentication state (login, logout, identity persistence) via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including user profile, preferences, visit count, and personalized dashboard, all using the actor from useActor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS entry point that imports Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark mode color themes with an agriculture/earth-tone palette.
frontend/src/lib/scrollToSection.ts: Exports a `scrollToSection` helper that smoothly scrolls to a DOM element by ID, dynamically offsetting for the fixed header height plus a 20px buffer.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with `QueryClientProvider` (React Query) and `InternetIdentityProvider` wrapping the root `App` component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: TypeScript reference file that includes Vite client type definitions for the project.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that maps OKLCH CSS variables to semantic color tokens, extends the theme with custom fonts, shadows, border radii, and animations, and registers typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
frontend/tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript compiler config scoped to the Vite config file, enabling composite mode with ESNext module resolution.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration with React plugin, `@` path alias, and manual chunk splitting to isolate React, Radix UI/Lucide, and DFINITY/ICP libraries into separate vendor chunks.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking existing features (Internet Identity auth, React Query dashboard hooks) and pending feature requests (per-user backend data storage, personalized dashboard UI) for the Terra Vedant Tech app.
